'''2017 Worlds Day 2 Mitch Nieland DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mitch Nieland]] at [[2017 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mitch Nieland]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open BHBM Nieland DS 2017 Worlds.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-world-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125012710/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-world-championships/ Internet Archive]
